name: schedule-availability-modal-polish
title: Fix availability matrix modal and schedule action emphasis
description: Keep the registered-availability matrix usable when no matching window exists, remove the black-screen/clipped-modal effect, and add restrained sage emphasis to important schedule actions.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Flow traced through availability schema/resolver, ScheduleManagement queries and modal props. Backend data contract and permissions were already correct. The page-scoped fix removes the hasWindow rendering gate, makes the modal lighter and scrollable, adds no-window and filtered-empty states, and restores visual hierarchy for important schedule actions. GitHub Actions run 28838066665 passed frontend/backend lint, tests, build, changed component tests, and Playwright smoke tests. Authenticated desktop/mobile visual review remains manual.
